prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: wide landscape scenic artwork for a literary writing app named Mirage Sun Theatre, no typography or UI. Create a genuinely theatrical and sophisticated hand-painted gouache and dry pastel scenic design, a view straight into an intimate opera proscenium. The image must visibly tell this idea: one sun, passing through different theatrical optical veils, reveals different story worlds. Three staggered translucent silk gauze drops are suspended in a deep stage, with their curved lower edges, overlapping scrims, side wings and a visible low stage apron. A pale apricot solar halo above and behind them sends a soft diagonal light through their layered painted surfaces. On one silk plane a cobalt harbour with tiny mast silhouettes, on the next a rose terracotta city with slender arcades, on the next a jade woodland with luminous white pathways. These worlds are integrated as overlapping painted theatrical landscapes, not framed separate postcards. Light changes colour gently at the overlaps; fine broken pigment, softly reflected colour and selective gilt edges create the depth, not neon effects. Tall indigo velvet wings and an elegant moulded ivory stage portal frame the upper and right edges; visible folds and small antique gold theatrical details, edited with restraint. Richly painted rather than minimal, but compositionally clear, cultured, strange, dreamlike, with sensual atmospheric depth. Palette dusty mauve, periwinkle, ultramarine, jade, warm apricot, warm cream; luminous light against richly dark side wings. No glitter or stars, no rainbow gradient blob, no shiny 3D fantasy palace, no photorealism, no people, no letters. Wide 16:9. Main optical stage and worlds occupy the right two thirds; leftmost quarter is quiet pale warm paper fading into a softly painted cream curtain, intended for readable real HTML text. Preserve fine hand painted irregular edges and actual detailed landscapes. Not sparse abstract geometry.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: wide landscape artwork for a novel-writing bookshelf, no words and no UI. Mirage Sun Theatre: different written books open different worlds on the same stage. Design an original high-end theatrical scenic maquette photographed by an art museum, tactile and dreamlike, with carefully modelled matte scenery and translucent glass. A clear monumental opera stage opening, dark midnight blue velvet legs, a slender brushed brass proscenium and a visible stepped stage floor. In its RIGHT TWO THIRDS, three enormous suspended bevelled optical glass/scrim planes at different angles and depths split the warm light of one large pale apricot phantom sun behind the stage. Each refracted vista is a fully visible beautiful mini story world: a cobalt nocturnal seaport of tall ships and bridges, a pale celadon botanical cloister, a dusty coral desert city of arcades and towers. The planes overlap spatially into a single continuous stage composition; coloured light cast on the stage floor connects cause and effect. The light seems to reveal the worlds inside the glass rather than merely shine around empty shapes. A low centre-right scenic rostrum is empty for a real HTML book to be overlaid. Visible side wings, suspended rigging detail and apron establish theatre, not a generic art installation. Deliberately crafted, dramatic broad light, strong chiaroscuro, surprising controlled colours of ultramarine, celadon, coral, amber, smoked lavender. Left third is calm deep midnight navy shadow, unobtrusive dark stage curtain, no detailed scenery there so HTML text will read. Camera level with stage, wide cinematic 16:9, well composed with light source and scenic worlds simultaneously visible. Architectural sophistication, physical handmade scene model, subtle material grain; no chrome sci-fi, no rainbow neon laser, no gold filigree everywhere, no crowds, no text, no logos.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: wide landscape theatrical art panel for Mirage Sun Theatre, no letters, no user interface. Artistic philosophy: books and the theatre both hold stories; the same light refracted through different layered scenery makes different worlds visible. A luxurious but highly designed hand-made Art Deco lacquer and eggshell-inlay theatre mural, deep aubergine lacquer, peacock jade, muted persimmon, lapis, ivory and sparing aged gold leaf. Depict a clearly legible miniature grand theatre, its curtained proscenium arch and gold-edged wing flats occupying the LEFT HALF. Three overlapping tall fan-like translucent scenic panels are suspended within the portal like turned book pages. A warm off-axis solar disc behind them divides its light along inlaid geometric seams into distinct painted worlds: a blue winding-water city, a rose-sand towered metropolis, an emerald cypress garden. Worlds have precise crafted silhouettes and deep layered stage shadows, illustrated with elegant sinuous lines and patterned lacquer, not photorealistic landscapes. Beautiful contrasting material fields, burnished and matte lacquer, eggshell mosaics, very fine hairline inlay. Show two shallow apron steps and little footlight points, so unmistakably theatre. Large shapes, refined ornament and strong composition, expressive and sumptuous without overbusy baroque decoration. Keep the RIGHT 43 PERCENT a mostly uninterrupted dark aubergine lacquer field with only subtle warm reflected light, reserved for live HTML title and description; no worlds or bright objects intruding there. Bottom band dark and calm. An original theatrical decorative artwork with actual recognizable narrative worlds and the connected optical sun motif, never just empty coloured circles. Wide 16:9. No text, no people, no glitter, no glossy computer render, no plastic crystals.
